name: Segmented control
purpose: Switches between two or three views of the same thing, side by side, such as a driving account's Vehicles and Licence, or Your topics and All topics.

origin.notes: iOS's segmented control, which the app draws with SwiftUI's Picker in SegmentedPickerStyle, unstyled, on its driving account and topics widgets. Its colours, shape and type are the system's, as the app's snapshots measure them.

label.description: Its name for screen readers, such as Driving, as the app's picker's label.

inputs.content: Two or three <govuk-app-segmented-control-item> elements, left to right. Mark the one that's showing selected. Give each an href, to make it a link to another page, or name and value, to tell it apart as a button. Its label is what's written between its tags.

events.name: click
events.description: From the link or button a segment draws, when it's pressed. A segment with an href goes to its page. A segment without one is a button, and pressing it selects it, as iOS's does; use event.target.closest('button').name to tell which was pressed and show its view.

rules: Use it to switch between views of the same thing, not to go somewhere new: for that, use a navigation row or the tab bar.
Use two or three segments, each one short word or two, so they fit side by side.
Select exactly one segment: the one whose view is showing.
Put it at the top of what it switches, 16pt in from the screen's edges, as the app does.

other.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Segmented controls

references.description: Vehicles selected, on the driving account widget, in light mode
Your topics selected, on the topics widget

examples.name: Segments that link to other pages
examples.html:
<govuk-app-segmented-control label="Topics">
  <govuk-app-segmented-control-item href="#your-topics" selected>Your topics</govuk-app-segmented-control-item>
  <govuk-app-segmented-control-item href="#all-topics">All topics</govuk-app-segmented-control-item>
</govuk-app-segmented-control>
